In this task, you will evaluate whether each statement is supported by its corresponding citations. Note
that the system responses may appear very fluent and well-formed, but contain slight inaccuracies that are
not easy to discern at first glance. Pay close attention to the text.

You will be provided with a statement and its corresponding passage which the statement cites. It may be
helpful to ask yourself whether it is accurate to say “according to the citation ...” with the statement following this phrase. Be sure to check all of the information in the statement. You will be given three options:

• Full Support: All of the information in the statement is supported in the citation.
• Partial Support: Some parts of the information are supported in the citation, but other parts are missing.
• No Support: The citation does not support any part of the statement.

Please provide your response based on the information in the citation. If you are unsure, use your best
judgment. Respond as either “Full Support”, “Partial Support”, or “No Support” with no additional
information.
Statement: The in‑game weapon economy, where players decide when to save, buy, or force‑buy, adds a strategic layer to each round.
Citation: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive Download for PC (Windows 10/11/8/7)
Introduction: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO) stands as a titan in the world of first-person shooters, captivating millions of players with its intense gameplay, strategic depth, and competitive spirit. Developed by Valve Corporation and Hidden Path Entertainment, CS:GO continues the legacy of the iconic Counter-Strike franchise. In this article, we delve into the world of CS:GO, exploring its gameplay mechanics, thriving esports scene, and enduring appeal among gamers worldwide.
The Essence of Counter-Strike:
CS:GO revolves around tactical team-based gameplay, pitting counter-terrorist forces against terrorists in intense combat scenarios. With precision gunplay, strategic decision-making, and objective-oriented gameplay, CS:GO demands skill, coordination, and quick thinking from players. The game strikes a delicate balance between individual skill and team collaboration, making it a competitive experience like no other.
Varied Game Modes and Maps:
CS:GO offers a range of game modes to cater to different playstyles and preferences. The iconic mode, Bomb Defusal, challenges counter-terrorists to prevent terrorists from planting and detonating a bomb. Hostage Rescue tasks counter-terrorists with rescuing hostages held captive by terrorists. Additionally, CS:GO features casual modes, Deathmatch, and Wingman, providing players with diverse experiences.
The game also boasts a wide array of meticulously designed maps, each with its own layout, strategic opportunities, and unique aesthetic. From the claustrophobic corridors of Mirage to the sprawling streets of Dust II, each map presents a different set of challenges and requires players to adapt their strategies accordingly.
Weapon Arsenal and Economy:
CS:GO's weapon system is a crucial component of its gameplay. Players can purchase a variety of firearms, grenades, and equipment at the start of each round using in-game currency earned through kills, objectives, or team success. The weapon economy adds a strategic layer to the game, as players must manage their resources and make strategic decisions on when to buy, save, or upgrade their arsenal.
The game features an extensive range of weapons, each with its own recoil pattern, damage output, and handling characteristics. Mastering the nuances of each weapon and understanding their roles in different situations is key to success in CS:GO.
Skill-Based Progression:
CS:GO's competitive nature is epitomized by its ranking system. Players start at the lowest rank and progress through a series of skill groups based on their performance in matchmaking games. The ranking system ensures that players are matched against opponents of similar skill levels, providing a balanced and rewarding experience. Climbing the ranks requires consistent improvement, teamwork, and strategic play.
The Thriving Esports Scene:

Question: Which company hosts and organizes the majority of CS:GO's professional esports tournaments? Answer: Valve Corporation.

</file>
